final: SELECT AVG(avg_pressratio), AVG(avg_size_per_minute) FROM (SELECT AVG(scans.pressratio) AS avg_pressratio, AVG(1.0 * scans.gbsize / scans.spanmin) AS avg_size_per_minute FROM scans JOIN sites ON sites.zoneregistry = scans.zoneref WHERE scans.chronotag > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND scans.chronotag < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY scans.zoneref, sites.typesite)
